material.commit_comment: stale: one Nostr signature takes about 1 ms on the live page; the 300 ms premise is refuted
material.description: secp256k1 Schnorr signing from nostr-tools (@noble/curves) is about 300 ms of main-thread CPU at startup. The cost is per signed event, and the code is in the vendored wireweave submodule, so the fix belongs in that repo. Move signing to a Web Worker there and keep the same event bytes. Witness: identical signed event for a fixed key and timestamp, and the startup profile without the noble frames.
material.subject: Nostr event signing runs on the main thread at startup (~300 ms)
material.witness: gm browser eval, dispatch 1792766084334-547-63b9cbe6645b7078: msPerSign 0.93 (40-sign average, live page). The 300 ms premise is refuted.
